Results.ReviewText: Very even heat over entire grill surface. The size of this gas grill is perfect for two people but, is also perfect for large gatherings. My wife and I love our Weber!!
Results.Title: New addition to the family

Results.ReviewText: so far we love it, cooked up some good steaks, nice even heating.
Results.Title: weber spirit grill

Results.ReviewText: Very nice. Heavy lid. Heats well. Great customer service on replacement parts under warranty or purchase.
Results.Title: Grill review

Results.ReviewText: Its been cold here in N.J. since I got the grill,but it heated up quickly and cooked evenly after I realized the temp controls worked the opposite of my old Weber
I got my grill 7years and love keep replacing some parts as they wear out or break
Results.Title: Great and long lasting

Results.ReviewText: I received this gas grill as a Christmas gift and am pleased with the construction and features. The only drawback I found was it required twoo burners being lit to maintain the 450 degree temperature I require for griloing burgers.
Results.Title: My New Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I love my Weber Grill. I've wanted a Weber for years and I finally purchased one.
I treat it like my car; cleaning and care.
Results.Title: I value my grill

Results.ReviewText: Terrific grill !  Weber still makes the best. I only wish side burners were available on more models.
Results.Title: Longest lasting grill.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble. Very good quality. Cooking is second to none. Best grill I have owned.
Results.Title: Perfection!!! The grill is worth every penny!!!!!!

Results.ReviewText: Our son requested a grill for Xmas. We decided that a WEBER grill would be the perfect gift for his up coming wedding. Danielle & Sean were absolutely thrilled and surprised, WEBER vs all the competition.
Results.Title: Wedding gift

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill. My 4th Weber. Highly recommended. Would buy again.
Results.Title: A year round grill for serious cooks.

Results.ReviewText: I have had multiple brands of grills over my lifetime and this was my first Weber.  In one word...amazing!  Regardless of the level of experience (or lack of experience) you have on the grill, Weber will take the guess work out of cooking over flame.  It cooks everything evenly and invokes a sense of confidence in your ability to use a grill.  Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Experience not needed on Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to light and heats up incredibly quickly but the two useful side shelves don't get hot.
Results.Title: New Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Nice features including how the gas tank hangs to let you know the propane level in your tank. Grates are well made and durable. Overall good value
Results.Title: E310

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill but the wheels make it hard to roll on a rough surface (pavers on the lanai). It is kept under cover and rolled out when needed. With heavy use on this surface, the wheels fall apart (this is our second Weber but the wheels are the same). Like the grill well enough to put up with the wheels.
Results.Title: Wheels wear out

Results.ReviewText: This product will not stay lit for anything.  I light it and it gets to about 200 degrees and then the flames go out.  I can’t even cook vegetables long enough on the grill.  Do NOT buy this grill.
Results.Title: Won’t stay lit

Results.ReviewText: Grill performance is as good as the 10 yr old 3 burner that I replaced. The cabinet in this model still hides the propane tank and has a gauge for how full the tank is.
Results.Title: Weber makes quality, long lasting grills

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size grill for all my grilling needs. I grilled our Thanksgiving turkey and it was perfect.
Results.Title: Perfect size grill

Results.ReviewText: Can’t beat this grill for the price, quality, and warranty to cover any issues for years!
Results.Title: Awesome grills, worth the money

Results.ReviewText: I like the way the grill cooks & looks, but it is very awkward to change out the with a new one. Not much room to get a new heavy tank in.
Results.Title: Awkward tank replacement

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber grills. I own 2 and won't buy any other.  They last longer and work better than any other grill I've ever had.
Results.Title: Great!

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve ever owned. Easy lighting and easy to move around. Temperature control is amazing! I’m a Weber fan!
Results.Title: Weber grill Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText: Quick ignition, and easy to control temperature. Excellent grilling surface. Great product.
Results.Title: Can't go wrong with Weber

Results.ReviewText: Performance is perfect.very happy with this product.
Results.Title: Best grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Weber Spirit E310 a little over 2 years ago. I used to have a Weber Genesis for more than 20 years and I was very happy with it. The Spirit E310 is nowhere that quality. The front stainless steel panel and the side shelves started rusting after 6 months. I clean them frequently but they continue to rust. And I store it under a covered lanai. The porcelain enameled flavorizer bars are also rusting. I contacted Weber but they said I need to register my product to get warranty service. I doubt that is the law. Based on my experience and the posts of others I do not think this Weber will last like the old one did.
Results.Title: Rust, rust, rust

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I (of 40 yrs) downsized about  6 mos ago and have been sorely missing our old Weber ( sold with the house). Finally purchased the E-310 and the 2 of us struggled to carry it up the 8 steps to the back porch. Couldn’t wait till the next day to hook it up and start grilling!!  Long story short, big wind blows it off the deck breaking a grill and the top irreparably. Saddest day in a long time. We were heart broken.  Incredibly, we called Weber later in the day and a few days later, there were the new parts ready to replace.  Amazing product but truly a much more amazing company!!! Thanks for you’re wonder support, your amazing grills, and the best company we’ve ever delt with.
Results.Title: Heart Broken

Results.ReviewText: We replaced our Genesis 4 Burner natural gas burner with the Spirit E-310 when we moved to our new home that didn't have a stub out for gas.  Very happy with the performance, in lot of ways we've liked it more than the Genesis!  We have a smaller deck area so it fits much better with our furniture.  Great grill
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had several Weber grills over the past years and I think they are the best grills period.  They cook evenly with no hot spots and the food always is amazing.
Results.Title: Greatest Grill

Results.ReviewText: 2 years old, rusting like all other reviews show!! I am done with Weber.
Results.Title: Rust Bucket - No Warranty

Results.ReviewText:
I have been putting up with cheaper gas grills for many years.  I was always fighting rust and corrosion.  The heat controls were marginal at best with constant flare-ups and burned meats.

I have only used the Weber once due to it being winter, but it performed as expected.  It was also easy to clean..

Can't wait for warmer weather so I can put it to the teste!
Results.Title: At Last

Results.ReviewText: You couldnt ask for a better grill weather your grilling steak or make skewers.  It cooks at the temp you set and evenly cooks.
Results.Title: Best grill I've ever owned

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Spirit E-10 for my husband and was delivered on Christmas Eve.  The stainless steel ends on each side of the grill are full of rust spots.  The grill is just over a month old.  This should not be happening.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: My kids gave me Spirit was my bday. We have an old Genesis 3 at home @ this new Spirit 3 at the lake. My wife is thrilled & loves how easy it is to operate & how even it heats.
Results.Title: Great features. Fast delivery

Results.ReviewText: Have always owned a Webber.  This one replaced my old unit.  Easy to put together.  First item on the grill was ribeye and salmon. Perfect every time.
Results.Title: Best $500 grill period!

Results.ReviewText: This grill was a Christmas gift. I am very pleased with the quality of construction and the warranty offered on the grill. It gets hot enough to quickly sear steaks but can be regulated to cook chicken more slowly. I'm  very pleased with the quality.
Results.Title: Excellent quality

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product as usual and great customer service for over 14 years . You pay more for the brand upfront  but they work with you for years
Results.Title: Excellent product and warranty

Results.ReviewText: Have enjoyed this Weber BBQ. Heats quickly and distributes heat evenly.  Easy to clean.
Results.Title: Weber - great features

Results.ReviewText: Well constructed . Made to last and very easy to use
Results.Title: Quality

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
